speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: When does the goddess shine Śiva-made?
premises: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force: body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing.
When time-cadre reaches dissolution-step of Yours — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
inference: Measure merged in proof; time-cadre met: shining Śiva-made.
